name: apexqueue-root
description: ApexQueue - Enterprise Distributed Job & Workflow Scheduler Engine

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,emerald" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
